data.name: Kuzo
data.detailed_description:
Paradise has fallen. You were born to restore it. The Shape encourages you.

Explore the secrets of a lush, hand-drawn world using a growing array of platforms and mobility tools.  Uncover the layered history of a fallen civilization in your quest to restore a metaphysical bridge as Kuzo, the long-prophesied healer of planets. The upgrades and hidden pathways each player discovers will determine a unique progression through the world.

GAMEPLAY

• Master the Shape, a platform-spawning projectile with fluid, omnidirectional controls.

• Adventure through more than a dozen hand-crafted environments in a dense, interconnected Metroidvania world.

• Solve puzzle-box dungeons, each with unique mechanics interwoven into the surrounding regions, and each housing a critical ability.

• Discover secrets both hidden and in plain sight as you gain knowledge of ancient systems, including a powerful musical language that can reveal the unseen.

• Help otherworldly beings trapped in remote corners of the abandoned planet.

• Unravel a mythology through environmental storytelling. What exactly happened to this once-thriving society? How will you act when faced with the truth?

Will you fulfill your purpose and connect with the ancient civilization that conjured you, or will paradise remain forever submerged? The choice belongs to you.

data.short_description: Explore an overgrown landscape of magic as you create your own platforms and shape your path through the world. Discover the history of a forgotten planet, collect relics to awaken your abilities, and create the very terrain you traverse.
